mapper.select:
SELECT product.insurance_product_id, product.insurance_name, product.insurance_category, product.insurance_description, product.monthly_premium, product.insurance_image, product.application_url,
matched_category.spending_category_id, matched_category.category_name, matched_category.parent_category_id,
COALESCE(match_tbl.recommendation_reason, '') AS recommendation_reason, match_tbl.priority
FROM kb_insurance_category_match_tbl match_tbl
INNER JOIN kb_insurance_product_tbl product ON product.insurance_product_id = match_tbl.insurance_product_id
INNER JOIN spending_category_tbl matched_category ON matched_category.spending_category_id = match_tbl.spending_category_id
WHERE match_tbl.active_yn = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM financial_transaction_tbl transaction_tbl
LEFT JOIN spending_category_tbl transaction_category ON transaction_category.spending_category_id = transaction_tbl.spending_category_id
WHERE transaction_tbl.user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_tbl.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND transaction_tbl.transaction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND transaction_tbl.created_at >= #{startAt} AND transaction_tbl.created_at < #{endAt} AND ( match_tbl.spending_category_id = transaction_tbl.spending_category_id OR match_tbl.spending_category_id = transaction_category.parent_category_id ) )
ORDER BY match_tbl.priority ASC, product.insurance_product_id ASC, match_tbl.insurance_category_match_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_insurance_recommendation_tbl ( spending_analysis_id, insurance_product_id, recommendation_reason, ai_recommendation_summary ) VALUES ( #{spendingAnalysisId}, #{insuranceProductId}, #{recommendationReason}, #{aiRecommendationSummary} )
mapper.select: SELECT insurance_product_id AS insuranceProductId, insurance_name AS insuranceName, insurance_category AS insuranceCategory, insurance_description AS insuranceDescription, monthly_premium AS monthlyPremium, insurance_image AS insuranceImage, application_url AS applicationUrl FROM kb_insurance_product_tbl WHERE insurance_product_id = #{insuranceProductId}

SELECT recommendation.insurance_recommendation_id AS insuranceRecommendationId, recommendation.spending_analysis_id AS spendingAnalysisId, recommendation.insurance_product_id AS insuranceProductId,
product.insurance_name AS insuranceName, product.insurance_category AS insuranceCategory, product.insurance_description AS insuranceDescription, product.monthly_premium AS monthlyPremium, product.insurance_image AS insuranceImage, product.application_url AS applicationUrl,
( SELECT match_tbl.spending_category_id FROM kb_insurance_category_match_tbl match_tbl WHERE match_tbl.insurance_product_id = recommendation.insurance_product_id AND match_tbl.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY match_tbl.priority ASC, match_tbl.insurance_category_match_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS spendingCategoryId,
( SELECT category.category_name FROM kb_insurance_category_match_tbl match_tbl INNER JOIN spending_category_tbl category ON category.spending_category_id = match_tbl.spending_category_id WHERE match_tbl.insurance_product_id = recommendation.insurance_product_id AND match_tbl.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY match_tbl.priority ASC, match_tbl.insurance_category_match_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS categoryName,
recommendation.recommendation_reason AS recommendationReason, recommendation.ai_recommendation_summary AS aiRecommendationSummary,
( SELECT match_tbl.priority FROM kb_insurance_category_match_tbl match_tbl WHERE match_tbl.insurance_product_id = recommendation.insurance_product_id AND match_tbl.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY match_tbl.priority ASC, match_tbl.insurance_category_match_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS priority
FROM kb_insurance_recommendation_tbl recommendation INNER JOIN kb_insurance_product_tbl product ON product.insurance_product_id = recommendation.insurance_product_id INNER JOIN spending_analysis_tbl analysis ON analysis.spending_analysis_id = recommendation.spending_analysis_id
WHERE recommendation.spending_analysis_id = #{spendingAnalysisId} AND analysis.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY priority ASC, recommendation.insurance_recommendation_id ASC

SELECT recommendation.insurance_recommendation_id AS insuranceRecommendationId, recommendation.spending_analysis_id AS spendingAnalysisId, analysis.analysis_period AS analysisPeriod, analysis.created_at AS analysisCreatedAt,
recommendation.insurance_product_id AS insuranceProductId, product.insurance_name AS insuranceName, product.insurance_category AS insuranceCategory, product.insurance_description AS insuranceDescription, product.monthly_premium AS monthlyPremium, product.insurance_image AS insuranceImage, product.application_url AS applicationUrl,
match_tbl.spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, category.category_name AS categoryName, recommendation.recommendation_reason AS recommendationReason, recommendation.ai_recommendation_summary AS aiRecommendationSummary
FROM kb_insurance_recommendation_tbl recommendation INNER JOIN spending_analysis_tbl analysis ON analysis.spending_analysis_id = recommendation.spending_analysis_id INNER JOIN kb_insurance_product_tbl product ON product.insurance_product_id = recommendation.insurance_product_id
LEFT JOIN kb_insurance_category_match_tbl match_tbl ON match_tbl.insurance_product_id = product.insurance_product_id AND match_tbl.active_yn = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN spending_category_tbl category ON category.spending_category_id = match_tbl.spending_category_id
WHERE recommendation.insurance_recommendation_id = #{insuranceRecommendationId} AND analysis.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY match_tbl.priority ASC, match_tbl.insurance_category_match_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT insurance_coverage_id AS insuranceCoverageId, insurance_product_id AS insuranceProductId, coverage_name AS coverageName, coverage_amount AS coverageAmount, coverage_description AS coverageDescription, coverage_limit AS coverageLimit FROM kb_insurance_coverage_tbl WHERE insurance_product_id = #{insuranceProductId} ORDER BY insurance_coverage_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT transaction_tbl.transaction_id AS transactionId, transaction_tbl.merchant_name AS merchantName, transaction_tbl.amount AS amount, transaction_tbl.created_at AS createdAt, transaction_tbl.spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, transaction_category.category_name AS categoryName, transaction_category.parent_category_id AS parentCategoryId, parent_category.category_name AS parentCategoryName
FROM financial_transaction_tbl transaction_tbl
LEFT JOIN spending_category_tbl transaction_category ON transaction_category.spending_category_id = transaction_tbl.spending_category_id
LEFT JOIN spending_category_tbl parent_category ON parent_category.spending_category_id = transaction_category.parent_category_id
WHERE transaction_tbl.user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_tbl.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND transaction_tbl.transaction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND transaction_tbl.created_at >= #{startAt} AND transaction_tbl.created_at < #{endAt} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_insurance_category_match_tbl match_tbl WHERE match_tbl.insurance_product_id = #{insuranceProductId} AND match_tbl.active_yn = 'Y' AND ( match_tbl.spending_category_id = transaction_tbl.spending_category_id OR match_tbl.spending_category_id = transaction_category.parent_category_id ) )
ORDER BY transaction_tbl.created_at DESC, transaction_tbl.transaction_id DESC

SELECT matched.spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, matched_category.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(transaction_tbl.transaction_id) AS transactionCount, COALESCE(SUM(transaction_tbl.amount), 0) AS totalAmount, MAX(transaction_tbl.created_at) AS latestTransactionAt
FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT match_tbl.spending_category_id FROM kb_insurance_recommendation_tbl recommendation INNER JOIN kb_insurance_category_match_tbl match_tbl ON match_tbl.insurance_product_id = recommendation.insurance_product_id AND match_tbl.active_yn = 'Y' WHERE recommendation.spending_analysis_id = #{spendingAnalysisId} ) matched
INNER JOIN spending_category_tbl matched_category ON matched_category.spending_category_id = matched.spending_category_id
LEFT JOIN spending_category_tbl transaction_category ON transaction_category.spending_category_id = matched.spending_category_id OR transaction_category.parent_category_id = matched.spending_category_id
LEFT JOIN financial_transaction_tbl transaction_tbl ON transaction_tbl.spending_category_id = transaction_category.spending_category_id AND transaction_tbl.user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_tbl.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND transaction_tbl.transaction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND transaction_tbl.created_at >= #{startAt} AND transaction_tbl.created_at < #{endAt}
GROUP BY matched.spending_category_id, matched_category.category_name
HAVING COUNT(transaction_tbl.transaction_id) > 0
ORDER BY latestTransactionAt DESC, matched.spending_category_id ASC
